name: Balearic Current
scope: Northern Balearic island-margin corridor from an OSW Ibiza offshore approach to a gate north/northeast of Menorca. Excludes upstream mainland Northern Current, its cyclonic return loop, southward channel flow, Algerian eddies and downstream basin recirculation. No full connected-system length.
layer: Upper-layer current along Balearic shelf/slope naming context; no fixed-depth axis reconstructed. June 1989 survey described a roughly 250 m layer, not one width at all depths.
time_convention: Regional island-margin reference informed by June 1989 FE-89 observations published in 1996 and 2020 model-comparison context. Not the actual cruise trajectory, annual mean axis, simultaneous observation or route valid through wind-driven reversals.
source_locator: Printed page 496 / PDF page 8, Conclusions: flow formed from Ibiza, follows Balearic shelf and leaves basin north of Menorca; printed 495-496 / PDF pages 7-8 describe channel/recirculation contributions and continuity limits.
source_citation: Garcia-Ladona, Castellon, Font and Tintore (1996), The Balearic current and volume transports in the Balearic basin, Oceanologica Acta 19(5), 489-497.

supporting_sources.citation: Ramirez-Romero et al. (2020), Assessment of the Skill of Coupled Physical-Biogeochemical Models in the NW Mediterranean, doi:10.3389/fmars.2020.00497.
supporting_sources.locator: Results, Horizontal Patterns: northeast current north of Balearic islands; NEMO-BFM restricted Mallorca-Menorca extent differs from other models.
supporting_sources.role: General direction and differing modeled extent; no universal coordinate axis or representative seasonal route.

supporting_sources.citation: Aguiar et al. (2022), Strong Long-Lived Anticyclonic Mesoscale Eddies in the Balearic Sea: Formation, Intensification, and Thermal Impact, doi:10.1029/2021JC017589.
supporting_sources.locator: Section 2, Study Area, paragraph on Northern Current split near 40.6 N.
supporting_sources.role: Northern Current branch contributes to Balearic flow; excludes entire upstream turn/loop from this island-margin length.

coordinate_selection: Every offshore vertex and gate is OSW-selected. Primary source gives Ibiza-to-north-Menorca shelf geography but no exact named endpoints, coordinates or full length. Alternative Ibiza/Menorca approach gates test extent convention. No source drifter track, hydrographic section or thermal front digitized; scenarios are not current width, seasonal evolution or measured endpoint error. Island-centre context points are approximate OSW orientation markers, not resolved coast outlines or clearance evidence.

alternative_routes.interpretation: OSW shorter offshore gates along the same island-margin corridor; not a Mallorca-only definition or seasonally observed contraction.

scenario_rule: Two selected island-margin gate conventions crossed with longitude and independent endpoint latitude offsets -0.05/0/+0.05 degrees: 54 editorial scenarios, not measured width, seasonal change or endpoint uncertainty.
